name: Signal Cluster S52: Switch Routing
description: Tests: switch(index, slot0, slot1, ...) — integer-indexed multi-value selection. Validates numeric and string switch variants.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER S52: Switch Transform
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
volume = src.v

# === Build an integer index: 0 when RSI < 30, 1 when RSI > 70, else 0 ===
rsi_val = rsi(close, 14)
rsi_high = rsi_val > 70
rsi_low = rsi_val < 30

# Use boolean_select to create 0/1 index
idx = boolean_select_number()(rsi_high, 1, 0)

# === SWITCH: select between two signals based on index ===
sma_20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
selected_ma = switch(idx, sma_20, sma_50)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Switch: Selected MA (RSI-routed)',
    category='Switch',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Selected MA', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 20', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 50', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(selected_ma, sma_20, sma_50))
